key_concepts: Acids taste sour and turn blue litmus red
Bases taste bitter, feel slippery, and turn red litmus blue
Acids release hydrogen ions in water; bases release hydroxide ions
The pH scale measures acidity or basicity from 1 to 14
pH below 7 is acidic, 7 is neutral, and above 7 is basic
Acid-base neutralization produces water and a salt
A salt is a neutral ionic compound
Strong acids and bases can burn skin
Acids react with metals and are corrosive
Household examples include vinegar, sinigang mix, and baking powder
Adding a base makes an acidic solution less acidic
